components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main action button with purple background
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #9f7aea; color: #080808; padding: 8px 16px; border: none; font-weight: 500; transition: background 0.2s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #b79ef5; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05); color: #f8f9fa; padding: 8px 16px; border: none; transition: background 0.2s; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1); }

components.name: Anime Card
components.description: Anime poster card with hover reveal
components.css: .ds-card { position: relative; aspect-ratio: 2/3; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05); overflow: hidden; } .ds-card img { width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; } .ds-card-overlay { position: absolute; inset: 0; background: rgba(0,0,0,0.8); opacity: 0; padding: 12px; transition: opacity 0.3s; display: flex; flex-direction: column; } .ds-card:hover .ds-card-overlay { opacity: 1; }

components.name: Navigation Item
components.description: Sidebar navigation link with active indicator
components.css: .ds-nav-item { display: flex; align-items: center; padding: 12px 28px; color: #6a6b70; text-decoration: none; transition: color 0.2s, background 0.2s; position: relative; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05); } .ds-nav-item.active { color: #9f7aea; } .ds-nav-item.active::before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; top: 50%; transform: translateY(-50%); height: 32px; width: 2px; background: #9f7aea; }

components.name: Dropdown Menu
components.css: .ds-dropdown { position: relative; } .ds-dropdown-content { position: absolute; top: 100%; right: 0; background: #1a1a1a; box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.4); padding: 4px 0; display: none; min-width: 160px; } .ds-dropdown-content button { display: block; width: 100%; padding: 10px 20px; text-align: left; background: none; border: none; color: #f8f9fa; } .ds-dropdown-content button:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1); }

narrative.overview: A dark, intimate interface for watching anime. Built for long viewing sessions in low-light environments. The aesthetic rejects the loud, gamified look of mainstream anime trackers. No flashy animations, no glassmorphism, no gradient text.
keyCharacteristics: Dark by default; light mode secondary

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Purple appears on ≤10% of any given screen. Its rarity is the point.

rules.name: The Weight Contrast Rule
rules.body: Headings use font-semibold (600), body uses font-normal (400). Avoid flat weight hierarchies.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. No shadows. Depth conveyed through tonal layering.

dos: Do use accent purple for primary actions and active states only
Do keep interfaces dark by default
Do use weight contrast for hierarchy
Do include back buttons on detail pages
donts: Don't use color to differentiate toast types
Don't use identical card grids with no variation
Don't use modals as first thought
Don't use green accent—violet is the one and only
